subject: german

rounds.lie: “Ich bekomme ein Geschenk” means “I am becoming a present”.
rounds.why: False friend — “bekommen” means “to get/receive”. “To become” is “werden”.
rounds.truth: “Ich bekomme ein Geschenk” means “I am getting a present”.
truths: “Ich verstehe mich gut mit meiner Schwester” means “I get on well with my sister”.
“Ich bin Einzelkind” means “I am an only child”.

rounds.lie: At school, “die Note” means “a short note/message”.
rounds.why: False friend — “die Note” means “a grade/mark”. A note/message is “die Notiz / die Nachricht”.
truths: “Eine Prüfung bestehen” means “to pass an exam”.

rounds.why: “Die Arbeitslosigkeit” means “unemployment”. A workplace is “der Arbeitsplatz”.
truths: “Ich möchte Krankenpfleger werden” means “I would like to become a nurse”.
“Ich kann mich auf ihn verlassen” means “I can rely on him”.
“Wir streiten uns manchmal” means “We argue sometimes”.
“Meine Eltern sind geschieden” means “My parents are divorced”.

rounds.why: “Das Rauchen” means “smoking”. A room is “der Raum / das Zimmer”.
truths: “Man muss fettiges Essen vermeiden” means “You must avoid fatty food”.
“Braune Haare haben” means “to have brown hair”.
